title: Digital Marketing & Performance Manager
description:
Take ownership of digital performance at Truespeed. Join our growing marketing team, turn insights into customer growth and help shape the next chapter of our expanding broadband business.

Digital Marketing & Performance Manager

Location: Bath
Salary: Up to £50,000 per annum
Contract: Full-time, permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home

About Truespeed

We're Truespeed, and we're growing fast!

Following our second merger in just 12 months, we've expanded from a mid-sized South West broadband provider into a national, multi-brand business, now reaching more than 420,000 homes across the South West, East of England, North West and West Midlands.

It's an exciting time to join our small, collaborative marketing team, with plenty of opportunity to share ideas, take ownership and make a real difference.

About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you'll take ownership of our key performance marketing channels, particularly PPC and affiliate marketing, with a strong focus on turning website traffic into new customers.

This is a hands-on, data-driven role for someone who enjoys understanding customer behaviour, analysing performance and identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates.

You'll improve results through smarter targeting, better landing pages, stronger calls to action and an optimised customer journey. You'll also contribute to wider marketing strategy as our network and brands continue to grow.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and optimise PPC campaigns, including budget management, forecasting and performance against cost per acquisition (CPA), orders and return on advertising spend.
- Manage affiliate partnerships, including price comparison websites and networks, monitoring performance, lead quality, tracking and payouts.
- Manage regional, brand and non-brand PPC activity across our expanding network.
- Optimise landing pages and customer journeys, including building and updating pages in WordPress and applying SEO best practice.
- Analyse website, campaign and CRM data to understand traffic sources, lead quality and customer drop-off.
- Identify and deliver conversion rate optimisation (CRO) opportunities through testing, targeting and customer journey improvements.
- Manage external agencies and partners, ensuring activity delivers against agreed objectives.
- Produce weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights and recommendations for growth.
- Contribute to wider marketing strategy, including activity across our brands and customer retention.
- Monitor competitor activity and industry trends, sharing ideas and insights with the team.

About You

You're a commercially minded, proactive digital marketer who combines strong analytical skills with a hands-on approach.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 3-4 years' experience in digital marketing, ideally in a performance or acquisition-focused role.
- Strong knowledge of PPC, SEO, paid social, UX and conversion rate optimisation.
- Experience managing multi-channel campaigns and delivering measurable results across leads, conversions, CPA and ROI.
- A good understanding of customer journeys, audience segmentation and targeted campaign delivery.
- Experience using website analytics, campaign data and CRM insights to inform decisions and improve performance.
- Confidence managing marketing budgets and forecasting.
- Experience briefing and managing external agencies or digital partners.
- Strong project management, communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A data-led mindset, with the confidence to challenge existing approaches and turn insights into practical recommendations.

Experience with WordPress would be an advantage.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary of up to £50,000 per annum.
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office and 2 days from home.
- Bath office location with free on-site parking.
- Private healthcare.
- A range of wellbeing, lifestyle and financial benefits, including 24/7 online GP access.

How to Apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Digital Marketing & Performance Manager position based in Bath, click "apply" today. You'll be directed to Truespeed's careers page, where you can find out more and complete your application.

Join us and help shape Truespeed's next chapter.

Please note: You must have valid authorisation to work in the United Kingdom, as we are unable to offer sponsorship for this position.

No agencies, please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Digital Marketing Manager, Performance Marketing Manager, PPC Manager, Paid Media Manager, Acquisition Marketing Manager, Growth Marketing Manager, Affiliate Marketing Manager, Conversion Rate Optimisation, SEO, Digital Marketing Jobs Bath.

title: Family Legal Assistant
description:
Family Legal Assistant

Bath

Salary up to 32,000

An established regional law firm is looking for a Legal Assistant to support its Family Law department in Bath. This is a hands-on role working closely with family lawyers and clients, providing both legal and administrative support while helping the team deliver an excellent service to people who may be dealing with difficult and sensitive circumstances. No specific professional qualification is required, but previous legal work experience is essential.

This is what you will be doing

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

£32,000 - £38,000

Are you looking to take the next step in your finance career within a fast-paced, dynamic environment?

We're partnering with an established and growing hospitality business to recruit a Finance Assistant into its finance team. This is a hands-on opportunity to play a key role in supporting the financial operations of a busy hospitality environment, ensuring accurate financial information, effective controls and insightful reporting.

Working closely with operational management and the wider finance team, you'll gain exposure to a broad range of financial activities, from daily reconciliations and credit control through to payments, reporting and financial analysis.

It's an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes ownership of their work and wants to develop their career within a supportive finance function.

The Role
- Complete daily revenue, payment, cash and card reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Review daily operational financial information to ensure records are accurate and complete.
- Maintain key financial performance reports, including profitability, departmental reporting and sales forecasts.
- Monitor outstanding debt, follow up with customers and support improvements in debtor days.
- Process approved invoices and payment runs, ensuring transactions are accurately coded and recorded.
- Support payroll productivity reporting by maintaining accurate daily sales information.
- Assist with accrual analysis and provide financial information to support the wider finance team.
- Work closely with operational managers, providing financial analysis and responding to queries.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role, ideally within hospitality or a similarly fast-paced environment.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Competent use of Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Excel.
- An organised and self-motivated approach, with the ability to prioritise and meet deadlines.
- Confidence working independently while contributing positively to a wider team.
- Experience with purchase-to-pay, invoice processing or purchase order systems would be advantageous.
- Experience using an accounting system such as NetSuite, or a similar platform, would also be beneficial.

The Opportunity

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established hospitality business in a varied Finance Assistant role, offering exposure to both operational finance and financial reporting.

If you're looking for a role where you can develop your skills, take ownership and make a tangible contribution to business performance, we'd love to hear from you.

company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your New Company

You will be joining a well-established private-sector manufacturing business based in Bath. The organisation has continued to grow across the UK and is looking for an experienced Accounts Payable professional to provide additional support to its busy finance function.

This is an initial three-month interim assignment, with the potential for extension depending on business requirements.

Your New Role
As an Interim Accounts Payable Assistant, you will support the day-to-day running of the purchase ledger and help ensure suppliers are paid accurately and on time.

Your responsibilities will include:
Processing a high volume of supplier invoices
Coding and matching invoices against purchase orders
Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
Preparing and supporting weekly payment runs
Managing supplier queries via phone and email
Setting up and maintaining supplier accounts
Liaising with internal stakeholders regarding invoice approvals
Supporting month-end processes, including accruals where required
Maintaining accurate accounts payable records
Providing additional transactional finance support during busy periods

What You Need to Succeed
You will ideally have previous experience working in an Accounts Payable, Purchase Ledger or transactional finance position. You will be comfortable working within a fast-paced environment and managing a high volume of invoices.

You will also have:
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Experience with supplier reconciliations and payment runs
Good Microsoft Excel skills
Previous experience using an accounting or ERP system
Confident communication and stakeholder management skills
The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines
Availability at relatively short notice would be advantageous.

What You'll Get in Return
You will receive a competitive hourly rate of £16.80 per hour, depending on experience, alongside an initial three-month contract with potential to extend. You'll join an established finance team within a growing private-sector organisation and benefit from hybrid working following an initial onboarding period.
